runtime.name: omp
runtime.configuration: Final hardened fixture plus generated poteto-mode and interrogate Skills and reviewer/synthesizer roles in a disposable Git repository; cursor/default at low thinking; asynchronous tasks; root liveness waits; no extensions or rules.
runtime.permissionProfile: read-only workflow with auto-approved read, bash, and task tools

assertions.evidence: The root read only the disposable repository's generated poteto-mode/interrogate Skills, references, and OMP reviewer/synthesizer roles.
The root loaded poteto-mode and selected interrogate for an adversarial review of a bounded design.
The root read requirements.md and both candidates and recorded their three expected SHA-256 values before its first task call.
One initial task call started exactly ReviewerA and ReviewerB before the root's first liveness wait or result read.

External transcript inspection found the two initial task assignments byte-identical at 5,029 characters and confirmed that each embeds all three literal files, hashes, the decision question, and the output contract.
ReviewerA and ReviewerB each yielded a complete separately attributable JSON artifact selecting durable-log; neither received follow-up, retry, or replacement.
Both ran through the generated reviewer role with read-only tools, and external Git inspection found no changes.
Only after both reviewer artifacts existed, a second and final task call started exactly Synthesizer1 with the frozen packet and attributable results.
The synthesizer agreement and disagreement maps preserve ReviewerA and ReviewerB attribution for every merged or distinct finding.
Both reviewers, Synthesizer1, and the root independently selected durable-log; the synthesizer retained the handler/checkpoint window as Consider rather than a disproven requirement.
The root reread all three files, rechecked matching hashes, ran node verify.mjs durable-log with exit 0, inspected clean Git status, and made the final decision itself.

Generated OMP custom roles were natively available; after a retained failed attempt exposed print-mode disposal, the rerun explicitly declared root-session liveness waits without messaging, retrying, or replacing children.
Root and external verification both found no diff and an empty short Git status.
No commit, push, pull request, or other publication occurred.

limitations: Reviewer and synthesizer model metadata all resolved to cursor/default, so model diversity was not established.
OMP represents a terminal child yield with an aborted model stop reason while persisting the complete role artifact; the root and external audit verified all three complete artifacts.
The verifier proves the frozen textual decision and hashes, not crash recovery performance or 100-events-per-second throughput.
OMP delivery remains D0 overall because the separate plugin-manager D1 gate is unresolved.
